name: Oyster porridge
summary: Oysters fried with onion, salt, and pepper, then simmered with red rice and glutinous rice. Eat it hot, while the oysters are still sweet.
origin: Phu Yen. Du lịch Phú Yên’s 6 October 2024 cẩm nang is the account of this porridge.
taste: Eaten hot, the porridge keeps the sweetness of the oysters.
howToEat: The oysters are fried with onion, salt, and pepper before they go into the pot with red rice and glutinous rice. Eat the bowl hot.
seoTitle: Oyster porridge in Tuy Hoa — eat it hot
seoDescription: Oysters fried with onion, then simmered with red rice and glutinous rice. Eat it hot in Tuy Hoa.
